scope: Visual inspection of the model comparison, not a whole-library or manual screen-reader audit.
initial_issue: At 390 pixels the original horizontally scrolling table hid the memory-aware score behind long byte values. A page-width test alone had not identified this reading problem.
change: This table now uses labeled row cards at widths up to 560 pixels; desktop retains the side-by-side table. The best row has both a text label and a border, and exact bytes remain visible.

inspected.result: After the fix, k=18/19/20 cards show complete time, memory and score values. k=19 is identified by words as well as color; no hidden score column.
The desktop table was visually checked before the responsive-card change: all six rows and four columns were readable. Desktop and mobile behavior both pass the updated browser test.

scientific_limit: Rounded scores can tie even when exact rational ranking has a unique minimum. The comparison stays conditional on the shard model.
